## August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 362)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio and South African broadcasting, five classic western adventures starring Earle Graser & Brace Beemer as *The Lone Ranger* with John Todd as Tonto for General Mills Cheerioats & Cheerios (1941–1952), and Michael McCabe in the diamond-smuggling serial *The Detective Galbraith Mysteries* on SABC (1941–1975):
